Gold Prices Steady Amid Iran Talks and Fed Rate Speculation

Gold prices remained steady as traders closely watched ongoing talks between the US and Iran. Progress in these negotiations was seen as a factor influencing energy costs, which in turn could affect the US Federal Reserve's decisions on interest rates. The US dollar also held near a two-month high, with markets weighing potential rate hikes alongside diplomatic developments concerning Iran.
